Capabilities.description: Offline scope. open/edit/play work offline; generation needs the listed items.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CaptionLayer.description: A second caption language drawn in the same safe band as the primary.
CaptionLayer.title: CaptionLayer

CaptionPlace.description:
A caption plate in frame pixels, read from a reference video or picked by hand.

``y`` is the top of the plate, not of the text. The saved value stays inside
the place area; the store clamps a write before this model validates it, so
the checks here are the safety net for other write paths.
CaptionPlace.title: CaptionPlace

CatalogId.description: Registry id of a catalog item. Validated by registry lookup.

CharacterSpec.description: Concrete part combination. Null when character_role is none.
CharacterSpec.title: CharacterSpec

CsrfResponse.description: Same-origin re-issue for a reloaded tab; the client keeps it in memory.
CsrfResponse.title: CsrfResponse

EntityId.description: App-issued id. Prefix p project, v video, s scene, l line, e element, c change, j job, a artifact, u upload, ps preset, rf reference.

LineText.description: One line's text in a second caption language.
LineText.title: LineText

Origin.description: Where a value came from. Precedence: user > reference > preset > card > llm > default.
Origin.title: Origin

PlacementAnchor.description:
Feet point of the character on a three by three grid over the visual area.

The unprefixed values are the bottom row that saved scenes use. The middle
and top prefixes lift the character above that row.
PlacementAnchor.title: PlacementAnchor

PrepareErrorCode.description: Why a group is retrying or failed. `failed` with no code is an unexpected error.
PrepareErrorCode.title: PrepareErrorCode

PrepareGroup.description: Progress of one model group. `done` and `total` count bytes of the group's files.
PrepareGroup.title: PrepareGroup

PrepareGroupId.description: A set of model files the app downloads together, in the order a user needs them.
PrepareGroupId.title: PrepareGroupId

PresetCaption.description: Primary caption a preset stores. The extra language layer is not saved.
PresetCaption.title: PresetCaption

PresetSettings.description: Settings saved in a preset. Language, length, topic, script and results are not saved.
PresetSettings.title: PresetSettings

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details plus the app extension members.
Problem.title: Problem

ReferenceLook.description: The look kept from a reference so a later style request can copy it.
ReferenceLook.title: ReferenceLook

ReferenceSummary.description: Kept after the source file is deleted. Holds no URL, no frame bytes and no transcript.
ReferenceSummary.title: ReferenceSummary

SemanticCode.description: Codes returned in the errors member of a problem body (CONTRACTS 1.3).
SemanticCode.title: SemanticCode

SpeechDevice.description: The compute device a speech adapter settled on, and why.
SpeechDevice.title: SpeechDevice

VideoBuild.description: Derived view, never persisted. Computed from cache keys and the artifact index.
VideoBuild.title: VideoBuild
